description: Presidential Secretariat - In terms of Section 17 of the Presidential Elections (Special Provisions) of Act No. 02 of 1981 that Hon. Ranil Wickremesinghe, Member of Parliament has been declared elected by Parliament of Sri Lanka as the Eighth Executive President
reasoning: This gazette content specifically announces the appointment of Hon. Ranil Wickremesinghe as the Eighth Executive President of Sri Lanka. It names the individual and states his basic title ("Executive President") but does not include any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities, ministerial assignments, or specific governmental functions he will oversee. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2) which covers government personnel changes with named individuals and basic titles only.
